[[Image:nqrlogo.png|right|NQR Logo]] == General Info == *Match format: Team DeathMatch *Continent: Europe *Start: 2001 *Headamin(s): [[Legio]], [[Icce]], [[gaz]] *Specials: Ladder, League, tournaments == History == Main article: [[NQR|History of Nations Quake Rank]]
NQR began life in 2001 as as a ladder competition. In its inaugural season, the initials stood for Nordic Quake Rank, and it was intended that the league was mainly for Scandinavian clans. After Swedish all-stars Flaming Fist took the NQR1 title, beating Finland's Clan Malfunction in the final, the NQR admins decided to open its doors to people from all around Europe, and so it became the Nations Quake Rank. == The NQR Hall of fame== === [[NQR Season 1|Season 1 -
